meta.description: Run a complete protein structure prediction pipeline using NVIDIA BioNeMo NIMs: search for MSA alignments with MSA-Search (ColabFold), then predict the structure with OpenFold3 using the retrieved alignments. Use for MSA-informed structure prediction with maximum accuracy using evolutionary information. This pipeline chains MSA-Search and OpenFold3.

functional_suitability.note: Complete 2-step pipeline with MSA search and structure prediction; paired MSA for complexes documented; minor gap: no guidance on handling Step 1 failures before attempting Step 2

reliability.note: Basic error handling with raise_for_status; MSA sequence count validation; missing: no retry logic for transient API failures, no validation that MSA depth is sufficient before structure prediction, no timeout handling for long OpenFold3 runs

performance_context.note: 197 lines within reasonable range; no reference files but content well-organized; minor: local Docker port conflict warning important but could be in troubleshooting section

agent_usability.note: Clear 2-step pipeline structure; MSA-informed vs single-sequence comparison documented; missing: no inline guidance on interpreting confidence scores, no decision tree for when to use pipeline vs individual skills

human_usability.note: Good trigger coverage; security warning about data transmission prominent; minor: 1.4TB storage requirement mentioned but not emphasized enough as barrier to local deployment

security.note: Prominent security warning about data transmission to external APIs in description; credentials externalized; no credential logging; proper separation of hosted vs local modes

maintainability.note: Clean single-file structure; clear delegation to component skills; minor: MSA structure format (uniref30/colabfold_env keys) hardcoded without schema reference

agent_specific.note: Excellent trigger precision; clear composability via msa-search-nim and openfold3-nim integration; pipeline rationale well-explained; lacks explicit idempotency statement; no consolidated troubleshooting beyond inline notes

recommendations.title: Add MSA quality gate before Step 2
recommendations.problem: No validation that MSA depth is sufficient before proceeding to structure prediction; empty or very sparse MSAs pass through silently
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes MSA-Search always returns useful alignments
recommendations.fix: Add after Step 1 count print: 'if n_seqs < 10: print("Warning: very sparse MSA ({n_seqs} sequences). Consider: (1) relaxing e_value to 0.001, (2) adding more databases, or (3) using single-sequence prediction if no homologs exist.")'

recommendations.title: Add quantitative guidance for MSA impact interpretation
recommendations.problem: Comparison section explains larger MSA typically yields higher pLDDT but no threshold for significant improvement
recommendations.fix: Expand comparison section: 'Significant MSA impact typically shows: pLDDT improvement >5 points, pTM improvement >0.05, especially for disordered regions or domains with many homologs. If difference <2 points, MSA provided minimal new information (sequence may be orphan or MSA too sparse).'

recommendations.title: Add consolidated troubleshooting section
recommendations.problem: Error scenarios scattered (port conflict in Before you start, storage in overview); no centralized recovery guidance
recommendations.root_cause: Inline notes sufficient for small issues but harder to reference when debugging
recommendations.fix: Add Troubleshooting section: '(1) Step 1 timeout → reduce max_msa_sequences or use smaller database subset; (2) Step 1 empty MSA → sequence too short (<30aa), all X's, or true orphan with no homologs; (3) Step 2 timeout → reduce diffusion_samples or switch to faster model; (4) Local port conflict → use distinct ports or run sequentially with file handoff.'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for pipeline execution
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on whether running pipeline multiple times with same sequence produces identical structures
recommendations.root_cause: Determinism of each step not consolidated at pipeline level
recommendations.fix: Add note after Overview: 'Pipeline determinism: MSA-Search is deterministic (same sequence/databases → same alignment); OpenFold3 with diffusion_samples=1 is deterministic. Multiple runs produce identical structures. For stochastic diversity, increase diffusion_samples >1.'
